CHAPTER.VERS: Jehovah reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He is enthroned above the cherubim. Let the earth shake!
Jehovah is great in Zion! He is exalted above all the peoples.
Let them praise your great and awesome name! He is holy.
The strength of the King loves justice. You have established equity. You have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.
Exalt Jehovah our God and worship at his footstool! (Isaiah 66:1) He is holy.
Moses and Aaron were among his priests. Samuel was among those who called on his name. They called upon Jehovah and he answered them.
He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept His testimonies and the commandment that he gave them.
O Jehovah our God, you answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, and an avenger of their evil deeds.
Exalt Jehovah our God and worship at his holy mountain, for Jehovah our God is holy.
